title: E2E: expand visual oracle with gradient, text, symbol, filter, and multi-frame fixtures
description:
apps/desktop/e2e/visual-oracle.spec.ts has only 3 fixtures (solid rects, multi-rect, tween frame 0). Critical render paths have zero Ruffle-vs-canvas cross-check coverage.

Add visual oracle fixtures for:
1. Linear gradient fill — a rectangle with a horizontal red-to-blue linear gradient.
2. Static text — a 'Hello Flash 8' label with an embedded Arial font at 24px.
3. Symbol instance — a MovieClip symbol placed on stage with a 30-degree rotation.
4. Drop shadow filter — a white rectangle with a blur=4, distance=4, angle=45 drop shadow.
5. Tween frame 2 — the tweened-rectangle fixture but asserting frame 2 (midpoint interpolation) not just frame 0.
6. Bitmap fill — a rectangle filled with an imported 64x64 bitmap pattern.

Each new fixture should follow the existing pattern: buildDocument() → loadDocument() → captureStageScreenshot() + captureRuffleScreenshot() → compareScreenshots() with threshold 0.20. Failures should attach both PNGs via testInfo.attach().

Key file: apps/desktop/e2e/visual-oracle.spec.ts.
